(Speculation, no information has been shown officially.)

The Pizza Oven is a concept for a new production building that is believed to arrive in Decemeber 2023 as part of the Christmas 2023 update. Little is known about the Pizza Oven, as it is supposedly still in development. This concept has not been confirmed, hence is not yet official. This article will be updated when more information is released about the Pizza Oven.

Description

The Pizza Oven is a concept production building unlocked at experience level 52. It is used to make various types of pizza. The Pizza Oven is meant to be an upcoming successor for the original three pizza products that can be made in the Bakery. The Pizza Oven will allow players to produce various different types of pizzas which will be inaccessible through the Bakery.

Appearance

The Pizza Oven will supposedly look like a Pie Oven and Bakery hybird. It will have a red brick structure with a rounded top, similar to the Bakery.

Products

Concept products include:

  • Hawaiian Pizza - Level 52
  • Cheese Pizza - Level 54
  • Classico Pizza - Level 58
  • BBQ Pizza - Level 68
  • Chocolate Pizza - Level 92
